thread:
anya: Quick thread — want to lock guardrails for Dedicated vs Private investment so prioritization is less fuzzy. goal: measurable launch criteria + a tiny RICE calc so we can batch decisions.

bryan_pm: +1. My strawman axes: (1) customer need (compliance vs throughput), (2) revenue/commitment, (3) engineering effort, (4) ops risk. Keep it simple.

matt_eng: For effort we should separate infra work (GPU + routing) vs control-plane (billing/rollouts). Rough numbers: infra spike 2-3 dev-weeks, full feature 3-4 eng-months depending on scope.

sophie_research: From interviews: enterprise legal teams request Private for on-prem/KMS more than Dedicated. Start with customers who already asked — higher R reach and convert.

vik_prodops: Ops guardrails we need: rollout canary, automated fallback to hosted model, SLA tier, and observable for token-level cost. Also quantify ops delta: private increases support top-end by ~2x for first 6 months.

anya: Proposed launch criteria (candidate):
- Dedicated GA: sustain 5k concurrent connections across pool, p95 latency < 120ms for 128-token gen, documented autoscale policy, customer commit >= $X/month or reserved capacity.
- Private GA: SOC2 + KMS integration, on-prem installer tested, audit logs, rolling upgrades w/ no more than 5% error bump, at least 2 pilot customers with contractual acceptance.

bryan_pm: Add business gating: minimum ARR or seat of support for Private (to cover maintenance). Otherwise funnel to Dedicated.

matt_eng: Quick RICE example to make this tangible:
```
RICE sample (one-off):
Reach = 8 customers likely to request Private in 12mo
Impact = 3 (medium — unlocks regulated accounts)
Confidence = 0.6
Effort = 6 dev-months
Score = (8 * 3 * 0.6) / 6 = 2.4
```

sophie_research: That math shows Private unlocks fewer but higher AR customers. For Dedicated, Reach is larger and Effort smaller => higher RICE for many scenarios.

anya: So operational decision rule we can use: if RICE_Private > RICE_Dedicated by >20% AND there are >=2 pilot commitments then prioritize Private track; else tilt to Dedicated with an isolation roadmap.

vik_prodops: Also add a safety clause: if customers have legal blockers (on-prem KMS, data residency) we must escalate immediately even if RICE lower. Compliance has veto power.

anya: Action items:
- @bryan_pm: draft PRD with the two GA checklists above and add business gating thresholds.
- @matt_eng: run infra spike to confirm 3-4 month effort and post a cost delta estimate.
- @sophie_research: validate reach numbers w/ sales and list 3 pilot candidates.
- @vik_prodops: outline rollback and fallback policy and ops burn estimate.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: prioritization-sync on Wed 09:30 — calendar invite created.

bryan_pm: Will post a first PRD draft by EOD Friday. If folks can react there we can RICE-score formally in the sync. :thumbsup:

anya: Perfect. Keeping this short — thanks all.
